name: kit
description: Kit MCP server with 85 tools for newsletters, subscribers, tags, sequences, statistics, forms, snippets, bulk operations and webhooks.
long_description: Requires eligible Kit API v4 access. Enter a v4 API key for personal automation or a private authorized OAuth token-file path for full endpoint eligibility. Audience/delivery/deletion changes require confirmation. Read-only exposes 38 reads. Credentials are never bundled. The same tools are available through kit-cli.

api_key.title: Kit v4 API key
api_key.description: Personal v4 key from Kit Developer settings. Leave empty when using an OAuth file. Never a v3 secret or account password.

tokens_file.title: Private OAuth token file
tokens_file.description: Optional absolute path to your regular private authorized Kit OAuth JSON. Required for OAuth-only bulk/purchases; never bundle the file.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed audience and delivery changes
allow_destructive.description: If disabled, refuse the 40 guarded operations even when confirmed.
